verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents delivery to a destination catalog: ClickHouse, BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, Postgres, S3, GCS, 'dozens of SaaS tools', and a generic HTTP/webhook destination, with a dedicated destinations integrations page. Its Functions filter, transform ('modify data to fit the schema of your destination') and enrich events before they are sent to the destination. Routing is controlled by which sources are connected to which destinations. Missing for 10: an enumerated catalog showing per-integration documentation depth, explicit evidence that mapping/filter functions bind per destination connection rather than globally, and independent hands-on corroboration of destination breadth.
